anti_patterns.name: Scaling before repeatability evidence
symptoms: Spend rises while cohort evidence is immature
anti_patterns.how_to_detect: Compare spend commitment with the available repeatability evidence.
anti_patterns.recommended_response: Keep tests bounded and collect cohort evidence.
anti_patterns.limitations: Symptoms are prompts for investigation; they do not establish causality or justify automated intervention.

anti_patterns.name: Hiring before validating the constraint
symptoms: Staffing is proposed without observed workload or bottleneck
anti_patterns.risks: Additional cost may leave the limiting constraint unchanged.
anti_patterns.how_to_detect: Look for observed constraint and capacity evidence.
anti_patterns.recommended_response: Map capacity and process constraints before committing roles.
anti_patterns.limitations: Symptoms are prompts for investigation; they do not establish causality or justify automated intervention.

anti_patterns.name: Revenue-only sales incentives
symptoms: Discounting or poor-fit deals grow while delivery economics weaken
anti_patterns.risks: Revenue may grow while contribution and retention deteriorate.
anti_patterns.how_to_detect: Compare incentive rules with margin and service outcomes.
anti_patterns.recommended_response: Review local incentive design with finance and the affected team.
anti_patterns.limitations: Symptoms are prompts for investigation; they do not establish causality or justify automated intervention.

anti_patterns.name: Metrics without a decision
symptoms: Activity totals rise without value evidence
anti_patterns.risks: Activity can mask weak customer outcomes.
anti_patterns.how_to_detect: Ask which decision changes and what evidence supports it.
anti_patterns.recommended_response: Keep an outcome measure with a named owner and review decision.
anti_patterns.limitations: Symptoms are prompts for investigation; they do not establish causality or justify automated intervention.

anti_patterns.name: Feature output substitutes for learning
symptoms: Roadmap completion is success regardless of observed value
anti_patterns.risks: Effort may continue toward an untested model.
anti_patterns.how_to_detect: Inspect whether shipped outputs changed the target outcome.
anti_patterns.recommended_response: Test one explicit hypothesis and review observed behavior.
anti_patterns.limitations: Symptoms are prompts for investigation; they do not establish causality or justify automated intervention.

anti_patterns.name: Strategy without resource choices
anti_patterns.how_to_detect: Compare committed work with realistic capacity.
anti_patterns.recommended_response: Choose a priority and explicitly defer competing work.
anti_patterns.limitations: Symptoms are prompts for investigation; they do not establish causality or justify automated intervention.

anti_patterns.name: Dashboard and meeting overload
symptoms: Many reports repeat without decisions or changed actions
anti_patterns.how_to_detect: Trace each review item to a decision or explicit no-action.
anti_patterns.recommended_response: Remove or archive items with no actionable purpose.
anti_patterns.limitations: Symptoms are prompts for investigation; they do not establish causality or justify automated intervention.

anti_patterns.name: Untested AI output treated as authority
anti_patterns.risks: Errors can be propagated at decision speed.
anti_patterns.how_to_detect: Inspect intended use, evaluation, oversight and incident paths.
anti_patterns.recommended_response: Establish evaluation and a responsible decision owner.
anti_patterns.limitations: Symptoms are prompts for investigation; they do not establish causality or justify automated intervention.
